entities.title: The state directory
entities.summary: One per-user directory holds everything zazzle-csharp-indexer keeps: store.db, usage.jsonl and usage.jsonl.1, daemon.sock and an optional config.json.
consumers: Every zazzle-csharp-indexer process of the user (serve, daemon, report, hook)
zazzled (macos/rust/zazzled/), which connects to daemon.sock to ask for terse C# views
The developer, who reads the log through zazzle-csharp-indexer report and may write config.json
entities.definition: Location: ZAZZLE_INDEXER_STATE_DIR, else ~/Library/Application Support/zazzle-csharp-indexer on macOS, else $XDG_STATE_HOME/zazzle-csharp-indexer or ~/.local/state/zazzle-csharp-indexer (configuration.json, state-dir). Files: store.db (SQLite, with its WAL files), usage.jsonl and the rotated usage.jsonl.1, daemon.sock (the daemon's socket), config.json (read for run.unrestricted).
guarantees: Processes using the same state directory share one daemon and one store.

entities.title: store.db
entities.summary: The SQLite database of roots, file records and analysed blobs, kept across daemon runs and versions.
consumers: Later runs and later versions of zazzle-csharp-indexer on the same state directory
entities.definition: root(id, path UNIQUE, event_id, full_scan); blob(id, oid UNIQUE, ver, size, binary, lang, lines, bloom, digest, symbols, idents); file(root_id, path, size, mtime, birth, blob_id, PRIMARY KEY(root_id, path)). Journal mode WAL, synchronous NORMAL, busy timeout 10 s; writes serialised within a process.
guarantees: Tables are created if missing; there are no migrations.
Blobs whose ver differs from Store.ExtractorVersion are deleted when the store opens, and file records pointing at a missing blob are analysed again.
A file record with blob_id 0 is a file too large to analyse.
entities.compatibility: A change to a blob's analysis bumps ExtractorVersion (src/Analysis/.dev/contracts.json, blob-facts). A change to a table's columns has no migration path: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS leaves an old table as it is.
